argv:
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uname -r
systemctl is-active gdm
for k in capacity temp voltage_now status; do printf '%s=' "$k"; cat "/sys/class/power_supply/sm5714-battery/$k"; done
for f in /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/smp2p-adsp/*/qcom,entry-name; do printf '%s ' "$f"; od -An -tx1 "$f"; done
for p in /sys/kernel/tracing/events/*smp2p* /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/*smp2p*; do [ ! -d "$p" ] || ls "$p"; done
cat /sys/class/remoteproc/remoteproc0/state
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
device_operations: read only; no remoteproc start, trace enable, flash or reboot
